rights.decision: The public repository does not grant reuse rights unless a later LICENSE file does so explicitly.

rights.assetClass: Third-party screenshots, copied text and stored model outputs
rights.decision: Publication requires verified provenance, clear attribution and the necessary provider, copyright and privacy permissions.

rights.assetClass: AI provider outputs and source lists used in a future site-run dataset
rights.decision: Future server-side retention, quotation, batching or redistribution requires provider-by-provider review. The current browser-local tools do none of these things.
The public website uses system font fallbacks and code-native graphics; it loads no third-party font or production image asset.
Reference pages link to primary sources and paraphrase narrowly supported facts without republishing source documents or protected artwork.

rights.assetClass: User-supplied answers, criteria, metadata and visible source URLs
rights.decision: Inputs are processed only in browser memory, are not transmitted by ai-fanout.com, and are exported only after an explicit user action.
